propositions: Rollout headers in mapping_config.py and apply_outbound.py do not document active mappings, Cloud/DC transport, and create/update paths.

Documentation of arbitration behavior conflicts between outbound_differ.py and written prose, and does not clarify when five inbound-mirrored fields suppress outbound writes versus when local behavior is retained.

OutboundDiffConfig is documented as having five values but the implementation contains nine fields, and the precedence of explicit mapping and repo_root parameters over config values is not documented.
Rollback semantics and consumer-specific effects of legacy mode are missing from docs/env-vars.md, and generated documentation is manually edited instead of regenerated from an authoritative source.
Documentation drift checks do not catch or prevent staleness of rollout headers, arbitration descriptions, and configuration field inventories.
